raw_text: UPDATE on AIIMS attack: Our contacts inside NIC confirm this is far worse than initially reported. The ransomware has spread beyond the primary e-Hospital servers to backup systems as well. Attackers had lateral movement across the network for at least 5-7 days before deploying the encryption payload. The initial access point appears to be a phishing email opened by a staff member. Manual patient management is causing dangerous delays in emergency care. Blood bank and pharmacy systems also affected.
